display.purpose: The decision title — the largest type and single focal point of the card (24px).

title.purpose: Section labels: Considered, Why this won, Related. Bold but small (14px/600).

body.purpose: Argument claims — the sentences that get read. Comfortable leading (14px).

label.purpose: Metadata — the date and owner line, the quietest tier (12px).

shadows.name: ambient-hairline
shadows.purpose: The card's only resting shadow. Barely perceptible; grounds the surface without lifting it.

shadows.name: tooltip-lift
shadows.purpose: Reserved exclusively for the source-excerpt tooltip floating above the card.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover/focus color shifts on interactive pills.

components.name: Decision Card Surface
components.description: The flat, square-cornered frame that holds the whole record.
components.html:
Adopt PostgreSQL as the primary datastore
2024-03-12 · A. Rivera
components.css: .ds-surface { background: #ffffff; color: #121e1e; border: 1px solid #acb8b8; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.10); max-width: 42rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-surface-title { font-size: 24px; line-height: 32px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-surface-meta { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; color: #536262; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Static label for a losing alternative under 'Considered.' Non-interactive; not used for filing metadata (no source-system or decision-id tags on the card).
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #acb8b8; background: #ffffff; color: #3a4848; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 9px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Source Pill
components.description: Interactive citation. Fully rounded to read as clickable, distinct from square tags. Opens the original source.
components.css: .ds-source-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #acb8b8; background: #ffffff; color: #3a4848; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-source-pill svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-source-pill .ds-trailing { width: 12px; height: 12px; } .ds-source-pill:hover { background: #f1f5f5; color: #232e2e; } .ds-source-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #f22b79; }

components.name: Related Chip
components.description: Same secondary pill as a source link, with a question icon — clicking asks the model about the related decision next.
components.css: .ds-related-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; max-width: 100%; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #acb8b8; background: #ffffff; color: #3a4848; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-related-chip svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-related-chip span { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-related-chip:hover { background: #f1f5f5; color: #232e2e; } .ds-related-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #f22b79; }

components.name: Winning Argument
components.description: A single claim led by the Signal Magenta dot — the card's entire use of brand color — with its sources cited beneath.
components.html: Relational integrity and mature tooling outweighed the document-store flexibility for our access patterns.
components.css: .ds-argument { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.75rem 1fr; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-argument-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-top: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e90060; } .ds-argument-body { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-argument-claim { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 24px; color: #121e1e; } .ds-source-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #acb8b8; background: #ffffff; color: #3a4848; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Source Tooltip
components.description: A dark inverted pill floating above the card to reveal a source excerpt on hover. The only element granted a real shadow.
components.html: “…we measured a 40% p99 latency drop after moving search back to Postgres FTS.”
components.css: .ds-tooltip { display: inline-block; max-width: 18rem; background: #071718; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }

narrative.overview: Y is a decision-history card that reads like a sourced brief. Every claim it makes is footnoted; the design's whole job is to make the evidence legible and then get out of the way. The card narrates a settled 'why' — what was considered, why one option won, what it relates to — and hangs a source link under each claim the way a paper hangs a citation under a sentence. The aesthetic is the evidence itself: crisp type, a hairline border, generous whitespace between sourced statements. Y does not own its canvas; it renders inside ChatGPT and Claude, inherits each host's theme and density, and never competes with the surrounding conversation. Its identity is a balanced signature: one accent color on exactly one element, a fixed reading rhythm, and a consistent citation pattern. The signature lives in structure, not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: One focused card, never a panel grid.
One accent (Signal Magenta) on one element; everything else is teal-tinted neutral.
A single typeface (Inter) doing all the work through weight and scale.
Flat by default: a hairline border and crisp corners carry the surface, not shadow.
Theme-adaptive: legible and on-rhythm in both the host's light and dark modes.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Signal Magenta appears on at most one element per card — the winning-argument bullet. It is never used for links, borders, backgrounds, section headings, or hover states. If a second magenta element appears, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Teal-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals carry a teal cast, never a warm one. Do not introduce warm grays, creams, or paper-beige tints; they read as a different product.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and scale within Inter, never from a second typeface.

rules.name: The No-Shout Rule
rules.body: The card title tops out at 24px. Display sizes above that belong to host marketing surfaces, never to a Decision Card living inline in chat.

rules.name: The Flat-Record Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only element that lifts is the tooltip, and only because it is genuinely floating above the content.

dos: Do keep the card to its essential fields: title, date, owner, losing alternatives, 2-3 winning arguments with links, related chips. If plain text wouldn't meaningfully degrade a piece, it isn't a widget.
Do keep Signal Magenta on exactly one element per card (the winning-argument dot). Its rarity is the signal.
Do keep the surface flat with a 1px hairline border and square corners; let hierarchy and whitespace carry depth.
Do carry the full hierarchy with Inter weights and scale (400/500/600), not a second typeface.
Do keep neutrals teal-tinted; the 'gray' here is always a desaturated teal.
Do distinguish facts from actions by shape: square tags for provenance, fully-rounded pills for clickable citations.
Do adapt to the host's light and dark theme; verify text stays legible against both Paper values.
Do preview the result shape in the loading skeleton, never a bare spinner.
donts: Don't add filing metadata to the card — source-system tags, decision-id pills, reviewer lists, status badges. The card carries the decision, not its provenance chrome.
Don't build a cluttered SaaS dashboard: no KPI tiles, no multi-panel admin chrome. One card.
Don't add heavy branded chrome: no logos, no gradients, no marketing flourish that fights the host.
Don't go playful or gamified: no mascots, badges, confetti, or emoji-driven tone.
Don't ship the generic AI-app card: no gradient-accent, glassy, or over-rounded 'template' look.
Don't use a border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on any card, section, or callout.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text over a gradient) anywhere; emphasis is weight or size, in one solid color.
Don't use glassmorphism (decorative blur/backdrop-filter) as a surface treatment.
Don't spread the magenta to links, headings, borders, or hover states. If you see two magenta things, one is a bug.
Don't exceed a 24px title; the card lives inline in chat, not on a landing page.
